evidence: Camera_Start handler of types 4/5/6: sets g_playerCameraMode (0/4/3), applies the followed driver's ChaseCameraSettings and builds the matrix.
Camera_Update handler of types 4/5/6: eases the record's chase basis towards the car by timeStep / lag (g_chaseCameraLag) and rebuilds the matrix.
Camera_Restart handler of types 4/5/6: takes the record's up/right from the reference matrix, then ChaseCamera_BuildMatrix.
Camera_SnapTo handler of types 4/5/6 and the last step of Start/Update/Restart: matrix from the record's chase basis, positioned at the view offset, pitched by g_chaseCameraPitch.
Camera_BeginEnter handler of types 4/5: copies the other record's chase basis when it follows the same car with a chase camera, else takes it from the matrix.
Sets a player's chase camera to the default settings (offset 0/1.5/6.5, pitch 0x2d, lag 14.0), as RallyData_SetPlayerDefaultCarSetup stores them.
Returns g_chaseCameraOffsets[player], the offset ChaseCamera_SetOffset stored (read back by the camera menu).
Stores a player's chase camera offset and the derived view offset, and refreshes the distance-scaled pitch.
Returns g_chaseCameraPitch[player]; the camera menu reads it as ChaseCameraSettings::pitch.
Stores the pitch and the copy reduced by the offset distance that ChaseCamera_BuildMatrix passes to FixMatrix_RotateAboutRight.
Returns g_chaseCameraLag[player] (ChaseCameraSettings::lag); also scales the view sway angle in Car.cpp.
Stores g_chaseCameraLag[player], the follow time ChaseCamera_Update divides the time step by.
View offset of a chase camera: the player's derived offset in mode 4, else g_fixedCameraDefaultOffsets[mode]; lowered in the split-screen view.
